command: $auditInference = Get-Content .deployment/inference-verification.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $auditFiles = @('.deployment/inference-verification.json', 'scripts/verify_inference.py', 'DEPLOYMENT.md'); $auditIdentity = foreach ($auditFile in $auditFiles) { [pscustomobject]@{path=$auditFile;sha256=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $auditFile).Hash.ToLower();bytes=(Get-Item -LiteralPath $auditFile).Length} }; [pscustomobject]@{inputs=@($auditIdentity);historical_cpu=@{baseline_seconds=$auditInference.baseline.seconds;baseline_peak_mib=$auditInference.baseline.peak_mib;deployment_seconds=$auditInference.deployment.seconds;deployment_peak_mib=$auditInference.deployment.peak_mib;exact_parity=$auditInference.parity;cases=$auditInference.baseline.results.Count;top_level_fields=@($auditInference.PSObject.Properties.Name)}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
inspection_scope: Bounded read-only inspection of existing local inference JSON, its current producer, deployment instructions, and two release manifests already readable during this turn; no live URL/provider calls or deployment changes.
historical_inference_limitations: Receipt has no execution date, source commit, checkpoint/image hashes, dependency versions, host OS/runtime identity, command, sampling trace, or cloud deployment ID.
'deployment.seconds' is the producer's local worker elapsed time across imports/initialization and four samples, not a measured Vercel cold HTTP analysis request.
Current producer samples process RSS every 20 ms and reports one observed peak; this does not establish memory below a threshold under deployed concurrency.
Two supplied validation images plus a stitched composite and blank image test small-sample output parity, not detector accuracy, independent evaluation or real multi-dish generalization.
The historical JSON has no bundle size, cloud logs, preview/source linkage, health-context interaction, journal reload, or Groq outcome evidence.
Current producer reads baseline code from mutable HEAD and writes a fixed historical receipt path; it was inspected, not rerun or treated as a frozen-baseline validation.

release_manifests_observed.interpretation: Read yielded source commit and per-file hashes. A later metadata/hash read was denied; manifest digest and deployed status not verified.
